_schema.description: v3 citation registry. Each entry is keyed by source_id. Every persona field citation in persona_citations.json must reference a source_id that exists here.

fields.source_id: stable citation key, used as lookup across v3
fields.title: authoritative title of the source
fields.authors: list of author or issuing-organization names
fields.year: publication year (int). For unknown, use null.
fields.publisher: journal, press, agency, or organization that published it
fields.url: canonical URL (for links; optional for PDFs)
fields.pdf_path: relative path from repo root, for pdf / data_bundle kinds
fields.archetypes: list of archetypes this source can ground (remittance, gig_worker, unbanked, itin)
fields.accessed: YYYY-MM-DD the source was added to the registry
fields.notes: free-form annotations — author manuscripts, duplicate flags, etc.

fincen_2024_identity_fta.title: Financial Trend Analysis: Identity-Related Suspicious Activity (January 2024)
fincen_2024_identity_fta.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, FinCEN
fincen_2024_identity_fta.notes: Primary file lives under remittance/ (first-listed archetype); applies to all three. Cross-cutting FinCEN typology source. v4: archetype list extended to include unbanked — SAR_ADVISORY_THIRD_PARTY_PAYMENT_PROCESSORS and FTA_IDENTITY_2024_T5 Circumventing Standards both apply to unbanked populations using prepaid cards / kiosk / unlicensed-MSB channels.

remitly_2024_10k.title: Remitly Global, Inc. — Annual Report 2024 (Form 10-K)
remitly_2024_10k.notes: Filed 2025-02-19 for fiscal year 2024. Market share, corridor volumes, user counts, pricing.

delreal_2022_venezuelan_legalization.title: Seemingly inclusive liminal legality: the fragility and illegality production of Colombia's legalization programmes for Venezuelan migrants
delreal_2022_venezuelan_legalization.publisher: Journal of Ethnic and Migration Studies
delreal_2022_venezuelan_legalization.notes: Author manuscript (PMC copy). Documentation-status and informal-economy context for VE->CO corridor.

menjivar_2022_tps_contradictions.title: The Contradictions of Liminal Legality: Economic Attainment and Civic Engagement of Central American Immigrants on Temporary Protected Status
menjivar_2022_tps_contradictions.notes: Author manuscript (PMC copy, available Aug 2023). Economic-attainment and civic-engagement trajectories for TPS holders; overlaps with remittance senders and ITIN filers.

vallas_schor_2020_gig_platforms.title: What Do Platforms Do? Understanding the Gig Economy
vallas_schor_2020_gig_platforms.notes: Foundational platform-labor review; grounds platform_mix, daily_cashout_pattern, device_stability framings.

wise_2023_remittances_report.title: 2023 Remittances Report: How to sustainably lower costs and achieve the UN goal of 3% by 2030
wise_2023_remittances_report.notes: Industry report on remittance cost economics and corridor fee benchmarks.

fdic_2023_hh_microdata.title: 2023 FDIC National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked Households — Full Release (instrument, technical documentation, codebook, and microdata)
fdic_2023_hh_microdata.notes: Canonical FDIC source for unbanked / underbanked / alternative-financial-services definitions and empirical distributions. Bundle contains: survey instrument (doc/instrument_2023.pdf), June 2023 CPS technical documentation (doc/Jun23 Technical Documentation.pdf), variable-frequency codebook (metadata/HH2023_CodeBookVariableFrequency.html), analytic-ready microdata CSV (hh2023_analys.csv, 309 MB, gitignored), and raw CPS .dat files (gitignored). When citing a specific sub-artifact in persona_citations.json, reference its sub-path (e.g. 'doc/instrument_2023.pdf').

fincen_sar_key_terms.title: SAR Advisory Key Terms
fincen_sar_key_terms.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, FinCEN
fincen_sar_key_terms.notes: Canonical FinCEN SAR typology taxonomy. Primary source for fraud_vector -> typology_code mapping. v4: archetype list extended to include unbanked — SAR_ADVISORY_THIRD_PARTY_PAYMENT_PROCESSORS and FTA_IDENTITY_2024_T5 Circumventing Standards both apply to unbanked populations using prepaid cards / kiosk / unlicensed-MSB channels.

oxfam_2018_central_america_myths.title: Facts, Not Fears: 4 Myths About the Mass Exodus From Central America
oxfam_2018_central_america_myths.notes: Migration-driver context for Central American remittance senders and ITIN filer populations. Publication date 2018-11-02.

iad_2026_remittance_year_in_review.title: Remittance Transfers in 2025: The Year in Review
iad_2026_remittance_year_in_review.notes: Annual corridor-level remittance review (Orozco tradition at IAD).

fed_reserve_synthetic_identity_fraud.title: Synthetic Identity Payments Fraud
fed_reserve_synthetic_identity_fraud.notes: Synthetic-ID fraud methodology and impact — relevant to account-opening fraud in wire transfers, platform worker accounts, and ITIN credit files.

treasury_oig_fraud_alerts.title: Treasury OIG Fraud Alerts
authors: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Inspector General
treasury_oig_fraud_alerts.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, OIG
treasury_oig_fraud_alerts.notes: Treasury OIG fraud alerts — IRS impersonation / tax fraud schemes (ITIN filer relevance) and wire-fraud phishing targeting Treasury programs (remittance relevance).

irs_soi_individual_tax_statistics.title: SOI Tax Stats — Individual Income Tax Statistics
authors: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income Division
irs_soi_individual_tax_statistics.notes: Canonical IRS SOI statistics for individual income tax filers. Primary numerical grounding for ITIN filer income, business type, and filing patterns. First ITIN-primary source in the v3 pool.
